meta.title: RM MARK — Coding & Marking Services
meta.description: RM MARK: industrial coding and marking in Morocco. Inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print & apply labeling.

hero.title_2: of your brand, at every speed.
hero.lead: For over 15 years, RM MARK has designed industrial marking solutions — from inkjet to laser technology — to identify and trace your products, on any surface, at any speed.

conversion.devis_text: Describe your need (technology, substrate, speed, quantity) and receive a tailored proposal within 24–48h.
conversion.visite_text: Have an RM MARK sales engineer visit your site to assess your production line and constraints.

about.title: Professionalism serving your brand
about.p1: A group of expertise built over more than 15 years in industrial marking and traceability. RM MARK offers a complete range of marking systems and industrial printers for identifying and tracing your products.
about.p2: From continuous inkjet to high definition, drop-on-demand, thermal transfer, laser technology and print & apply labeling — RM MARK brings you a marking solution tailored to all your needs.
about.proc1_text: High-speed marking on all industrial substrates.
about.proc2_text: Crisp printing on flexible substrates and packaging.
about.proc4_text: Custom solution, tailored to all your needs.

services.title: Technical support across Morocco
services.text: RM MARK offers a full range of services for your marking systems. Reach our technical hotline: our team will guide you to the solution best suited to your needs. RM MARK responds quickly, anywhere in Morocco.

solutions.title: A technology for every surface, every speed
solutions.text: Small & large character — high resolution — thermal transfer — laser — print & apply.
solutions.s1_text: Alphanumeric marking on all substrates, for all types of industries.
solutions.s2_text: Logos, text and barcodes on all substrates. Portable or fixed system.
solutions.s3_text: Logos, text, barcodes and images on all substrates, sharp and precise rendering.
solutions.s4_text: Logos, text and barcodes on all flexible substrates, continuous or intermittent mode.
solutions.s5_text: Fully permanent traceability marking, CO₂ Laser or Fiber Laser.
solutions.s6_text: Complete printing and label-applying system, for all types of substrates.

consumables.title: Everything to keep your printers running
consumables.text: Original consumables and spare parts for your whole fleet of industrial printers.
consumables.c1_text: Formulations suited to each marking technology, plus cleaning solutions.
consumables.c2_text: Thermal transfer consumables for crisp printing, run after run.
consumables.c3_text: Filters, pumps, solenoid valves and electronic boards for all your printers.
consumables.c4_text: Fast supply across the whole of Morocco.

conseils.title: Maintenance, training & supply
conseils.text: Complete support to maximize your machines' uptime.
conseils.k1_text: After assessment, we offer a tailored maintenance contract including:
conseils.k1_li3: Possible loan printer during servicing or repairs
conseils.k2_text: We offer custom training, on-site or at our training center, tailored to your teams' level.
conseils.k3_text: We supply consumables and spare parts for your industrial printers, wherever you are in Morocco.

contact.title: Let's talk about your marking project
contact.text: Our technical team is available to review your needs and propose the right solution.

footer.text: Industrial coding and marking. Small & large character, high resolution, thermal transfer, laser, print & apply — serving your brand's traceability, across Morocco.
